mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) may inhibit ethosuximide metabolism and increase seizure threshold alteration risk through CNS effects, while ethosuximide may theoretically lower seizure threshold and interact with monoamine metabolism.
action: Monitor seizure control closely; consider alternative antidepressant if possible; if combination necessary, use lowest effective doses and monitor for increased ethosuximide levels and adverse effects.
